fixture_policy: Direct tests retain the two literal resolution calls and resolution-only assertions from formula/INFO conversion examples. Independent custom AST/registry cases are inline Rust fixtures, not output from production. No new C++ probe or full SDK execution is claimed; historical parser/writer/JSON/probe manifests are unchanged.
implemented_scope: Peptidoform::resolve_modifications with caller-owned ModificationsDB and atomic registry/AST publication.
Owned typed diagnostics for missing alias keys, ambiguous CV selection and INFO-definition disagreement.
Complete public source traversal, including deliberate omission of ModifiedRange element annotations; exact first-chemistry and empty-alternatives behavior.
Canonical neutral formula interning with immutable Arc identity and source absolute mass defaults.
remaining_scope: AASequence conversion/combination, complete policies and issue/can variants.
Ordinary/XLMS spectrum generation and corresponding backend.
native_differences: First native provider match replaces unspecified source pointer ordering; CV preserves Anywhere-first retry, with ambiguity returned as a diagnostic. Generic native registry lookup is unchanged.
Explicit mutable registry and owned warning records replace global DB/logger state; failure publishes neither registry nor handle mutations.

Native char is a Unicode scalar rather than C++ raw byte; formula sites require known ASCII residue codes, while named queries use scalar equality/source wildcard behavior. Complete valid UTF-8 names and INFO text are retained.

Existing native formula syntax/checked i32 counts/element data and deterministic mass order apply. Invalid or unrepresentable formula parsing becomes unresolved; resource exhaustion remains a call-level error.
Nonfinite consumed MassDelta values are errors; unused label/charge/glycan fields remain unconsumed.
Repeated index copies and comparisons are conservatively charged against one shared budget; logical allocation allowance is not a physical-memory ceiling.
licensing: Source-derived code retains OpenMS copyright and BSD-3-Clause notices; no external implementation or dependency is introduced.
native_base_note: The isolated working snapshot also included root-owned in-flight DocumentIdentifier updates. These and all shared status files are excluded from this nine-file extraction.
